name: When should I call a restoration company after storm damage?

mainEntity.name: When should I call a restoration company after storm damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should contact a restoration company immediately after ensuring the safety of your occupants and property. Prompt action is crucial to mitigate further damage, especially water-related issues that can quickly lead to mold growth and structural compromise. A rapid response helps in documenting the damage for insurance claims and beginning the restoration process to minimize business interruption. Early intervention can significantly reduce overall repair costs and recovery time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Contact a restoration company immediately after a storm to prevent further damage, especially water-related issues, and to start the insurance claim process promptly.
